pages.title: Bones Put to Use
pages.text: Process a legitimately earned trophy into chosen useful equipment.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Earn teeth/bones through their actual encounters. Trident and bone armor are different trophy-processing routes; this quest gives supporting consumables, not another finished boss weapon.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A trophy becomes useful gear through its native recipe; item grants do not replace its encounter.
